items.markdown:
To make authentic Thai fried rice (*khao pad* ), you need `day-old jasmine rice, egg, aromatics like garlic and onion, and a savory sauce made from soy and fish sauce` . Common proteins include chicken, shrimp, or tofu.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-chicken-fried-rice/) [[1]](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-chicken-fried-rice/)[[2]](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-fried-rice-recipe-shrimp/)[[3]](https://rosasthai.com/recipes/thai-style-fried-rice-with-shrimp-or-prawns)[[4]](https://www.skinnytaste.com/thai-fried-rice-575-pts/)

Key Ingredients for Thai Fried Rice:

- **The Rice:** 3–4 cups of cold, day-old cooked jasmine rice (chilled overnight so it doesn't clump).[](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-chicken-fried-rice/) [[1]](https://www.facebook.com/thespruceeats/posts/this-thai-fried-rice-recipe-is-your-go-to-for-make-at-home-food-its-made-with-fr/1021882839979508/)[[2]](https://www.taste.com.au/recipes/tuna-pineapple-thai-fried-rice-recipe/42im3eb6)
- **Aromatics:** 3–4 cloves of minced garlic, 1 small diced onion or shallot.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-chicken-fried-rice/) [[1]](https://www.feastingathome.com/thai-fried-rice/)
- **Protein:** 150g–200g of sliced chicken, peeled shrimp, or cubed tofu.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-chicken-fried-rice/) [[1]](https://cooking.nytimes.com/recipes/1014004-thai-combination-fried-rice)
- **The Eggs:** 2 large eggs, lightly beaten.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-chicken-fried-rice/) 
- **The Sauce Mix:** 
	- 1–2 tbsp fish sauce (provides the salty, savory base).
	- 1 tbsp soy sauce or Thai seasoning sauce.
	- 1 tsp oyster sauce.
	- 1 2 one-half 1 2 tsp white sugar (to balance the saltiness).[](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-fried-rice-recipe-shrimp/) [[1]](https://www.chilipeppermadness.com/recipes/thai-fried-rice/)[[2]](https://www.thespruceeats.com/classic-thai-chicken-fried-rice-3217140)[[3]](https://www.swiggy.com/instamart/recipe/thai-fried-rice)
- **Veggies & Garnish:** 1 diced tomato, a handful of Chinese broccoli or peas, and chopped spring onions.[](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-fried-rice-recipe-shrimp/) 
- **Frying Oil:** 2 tbsp vegetable or canola oil.[](https://www.recipetineats.com/thai-chicken-fried-rice/) 

*Optional but traditional additions include thinly sliced Thai bird's eye chilies or a pinch of ground white pepper added to the finished dish.* [](https://thewoksoflife.com/thai-fried-rice/) [[1]](https://thewoksoflife.com/thai-fried-rice/)For tips on how to get the seasoning, heat, and texture just right:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRdYqm-dyQb4FKZOXDDeV1fYx5GYpRKhoyVrYb5wbTfRM_QcxeO)

expanded_element.description: This dish normally contains meat (chicken, shrimp, and crab are all common), egg, onions, garlic and sometimes tomatoes. The seasonings, which may include soy sauce, sugar, salt, possibly some chili sauce, and the ubiquitous nam pla (Thai fish sauce), are stir-fried together with the other ingredients.
